title: Comfort and Joy | Real Joy
meta_description: Top Reasons to Book this Beautiful Home:* Multiple Balconies and Porch Swing* About 700 yards to the Beach  * Gas Grill and Outdoor Shower* Huge 12,000sqft Community Pool * 4 Bicycles Included* FREE Seasonal Tram Service to the Beach and Pool *
description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Beautiful Home:* Multiple Balconies and Porch Swing* About 700 yards to the Beach * Gas Grill and Outdoor Shower* Huge 12,000sqft Community Pool * 4 Bicycles Included* FREE Seasonal Tram Service to the Beach and Pool * Walk to Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach* Snorkel the Grouper Reef-more info under Area Attractions below* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service "Please be aware that there is ongoing construction near the home."*This property is NOT AVAILABLE for rent to those under the age of 25. No Exceptions.* **The Lagoon Pool will be resurfaced. This project will take approximately 4 weeks. Start date on this process is Monday, Oct 27th, 2025. The pool deck will be closed during this time as well due to the safety hazards during this project. We anticipate opening the complex on Monday, November 24th, 2025. During this time, our Neighbors at the Village of South Walton will be allowing the use of our wristbands at their pool complex. ***Parking passes will be provided equal to the number of bedrooms in the home. Not all parking spots are located directly by the home. Additional passes may be purchased for $50 each. Wristbands are required for use of the Seacrest Beach amenities and are limited to the maximum occupancy of the home.**** there is on going construction across the street***Comfort and Joy is a spacious 2380 sqft, 4BR/3.5BA home in the Seacrest Beach community, just off Scenic Hwy 30A. Situated about 700 yards from beach access and walking distance to Rosemary Beach, this stunning home offers a bright, open floor plan with gorgeous hardwood flooring and granite counters in the gourmet kitchen! With 2 King Masters, a Guest Room with Queen Bed, twin bunk room, and twin bunk nook, this lovely beach home sleeps 10 guests comfortably. Chill on one of the balconies or the downstairs porch swing, take a dip in the huge community pool, or ride your bike to the beautiful beaches! Enjoy lasting memories by making Comfort and Joy your next beach vacation tradition! Seacrest Beach Community is perfectly nestled between Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach on Hwy 30A. This luxury development offers an array of amenities including deeded beach access just across the street, a huge 12,000sqft community lagoon pool, an amphitheater, seasonal tram service to the beach or pool, and 1.35 miles of walking trails! The convenient location is within walking distance to world class dining, spas, wine bars, and many wonderful locally owned shops! Come see why friends and families vacation at Seacrest Beach year after year! The Bed Setup: 1st Floor Master w/ King Bed Guest Room w/ Queen Bed Bunk Nook w/ Twin Bunks 3rd Floor Master w/ King Bed Guest Room w/ Twin Bunks Area Attractions: Rosemary Beach is only minutes away, with shops and restaurants, including the Old World style town center w/coffee shop, bike and surf rentals, and unique shops. Check out the open-air markets on the weekends. Enjoy the beautiful sugar white sand beaches that made 30A world famous. Enjoy walking and biking everywhere around Rosemary, Seacrest, and Alys. Don't miss the newly opened 30Avenue for even more dining and shopping options. 30Avenue is just north of Rosemary across Hwy 98, near both Shades Sports Bar and The Donut Hole. This laid back, fun family atmosphere awaits you! Come stay and play and see for yourself what makes our community and the 30A area so special! The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Grouper Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 970 feet out from the Inlet Beach access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Grouper Reef is at a depth of 12-21 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
